mandatory_notice: Automated interpretation, decision support only. Verify clinically.
clinical_review_note: These automated threshold rules are approximations based on percent-predicted values and a fixed FEV1/FVC cutoff when GLI lower-limit-of-normal (LLN) and z-scores are not used. They must be reviewed and approved by a qualified clinician before any real clinical use.

caution.lung_function_overlap_statement: Lung function alone cannot separate IPF from other fibrosing interstitial lung diseases.

clinician_considerations.guideline_reference: ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT IPF Clinical Practice Guidelines (2018; 2022 update)
items: HRCT pattern review (evaluating UIP, probable UIP, indeterminate, or alternative patterns)
Exposure and autoimmune history (environmental/occupational exposures, medications, and connective tissue disease evaluation)
Multidisciplinary discussion (MDD) integrating clinical, radiologic, and laboratory findings
